integrity: The circulant orthogonal-projection formula and cyclic Latin transversal existence/obstruction are credited as established background. New conclusions concern the two-polytope Hausdorff extremum, rigidity, and the exact first nonmaximal vertex shell; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Frobenius metric only; second level is among permutation vertices, not arbitrary convex combinations; the count of farthest permutations in general dimension is not determined; historical priority may require additional review.
title: A parity-sharp Hausdorff and vertex-gap theorem for cyclic stochastic permutation polytopes
